advancements.doctor_m.root.title: DOCTOR M
advancements.doctor_m.root.description: Why is it called DOCTOR M? Well... DOCTOR MOD, DOCTOR MC, anyway it's multi-layered~
advancements.doctor_m.enter_trenzalore.d: In a snow-swept town, an aged warrior awaits his final bell; his honored old shell is about to turn a new page.
item.doctor_m.rassilon_key.tooltip.line1: Authorization tool for the Time Lords' forbidden weapon
item.doctor_m.rassilon_key.tooltip.line2: Few Presidents have been granted the Key of Rassilon...
item.doctor_m.de_mat_gun.tooltip.line1: A warning from the Time Lords:
item.doctor_m.de_mat_gun.tooltip.line2: Destroy this gun, erase all its data. Do not let its power corrupt your mind...
